title: invocation-decorators-and-alert-synthesis-engine
author: Marta Lopez
description: Summary: Adds an invocation-level 'decorator' pipeline that enriches spans and metrics at request entry/exit and introduces an Alert Synthesis Engine that coalesces noisy, per-token alerts into single actionable incidents. Motivation: alert fatigue from token-level and phase-level SLO fires makes triage slow; many noisy alerts stem from the same underlying invocation pattern (e.g. long-tail prompt shapes, cold-cache microbursts). This PR delivers two orthogonal pieces: 1) lightweight invocation decorators that attach stable invocation keys and canonicalized prompt-shape metadata to traces/metrics and 2) an offline/stream synthesis service that groups alert signals by invocation fingerprint and applies heuristic suppression/priority fusion before page routing. Changes: - inference/proxy/middleware/decorators.go: new middleware that computes invocation_fingerprint, prompt_shape_bucket and attaches them to OpenTelemetry spans and the request envelope. - observability/synthesis/engine.py: synthesis engine that consumes alert events, enriched spans, and rule configuration; outputs fused alerts and a short provenance blob used by the runbook UI. - observability/synthesis/config.yaml.example: operator editable rules for fusion thresholds, time-windows and priority escalation. - dashboards/observability/invocation-synthesis-panel.json: Grafana panel showing synthesis rate, fusion ratio, and top contributing invocation fingerprints. - tests/observability/test_synthesis_engine.py: unit + regression tests covering grouping heuristics, TTLs and priority escalation. - internal/metrics/labels.go: new stable labels (invocation_fingerprint, prompt_shape_bucket) and helper APIs. - ci/workflows/obs-integration.yml: adds staged integration job that runs synthesis smoke tests against sampled production traces. Commits (summary): - 1a2b3c4: add decorators middleware and label helpers - 4d5e6f7: initial synthesis engine + clustering heuristics - 7f8e9d0: add dashboards and CI integration job - ab12cd3: tests and docs; tweak fusion thresholds for stage Review notes: - Design rationale: Prefer deterministic fingerprint generation (sha1 over normalized prompt+client+route) to keep cardinality capped. We intentionally avoid adding new high-cardinality user identifiers. - Performance: decorator added ~120ns median overhead in hot path (benchmarked on canary infra). Batch tracing exporter unchanged. - Backwards compatibility: spans get new attributes but old consumers will ignore them; no schema migration required. Review conversation (high level): - Sanjay Patel (reviewer): "Can the fingerprint collide across tenants when prompt shapes are similar? Please add test asserting different tenant ids produce different fingerprints." -> Author: "Added tenant ID salt to fingerprint and a unit test (tests/observability/test_fingerprint_tenant_salt.py)." - Elliot Zhang (reviewer): "What happens if synthesis engine is down?" -> Author: "Engine runs best-effort; alerts are ingested into the canonical alert queue. Synthesis runs as a consumer with at-least-once semantics and includes a pass-through mode if disabled (config flag: enable_synthesis:false). Added runbook note." - Nora Mills (approver): "Please document how ops can tune fusion thresholds. Approved after docs update." CI summary: - go-build: pass - py-tests: initial run failed on edge TTL case, rerun passed - lint (golangci + flake8): pass - integration-tests: pass (staged job against sampled traces) Final CI status: pass Files changed (high level): - 18 files changed across middleware, observability synthesis, dashboards, tests and CI. Additions: 1243 deletions: 312 Release notes: "Introduces invocation decorators to enrich spans/metrics with stable invocation fingerprints and prompt-shape buckets; adds an Alert Synthesis Engine that groups related alert signals into single incidents to reduce alert fatigue. Ops can tune fusion thresholds via observability/synthesis/config.yaml.example." Merge: merged via squash, commit message: "invocation decorators + alert synthesis engine: reduce alert noise and add fusion controls"; merger: "Elliot Zhang"; merge date: 2026-03-02. Follow-ups & rollout plan: - Canary rollout: decorator enabled for 10% of traffic in us-west-2 for 48h, monitor fusion ratio and false positive suppression. - Metrics to watch: synthesis_fusion_ratio, synthesis_group_latency_ms, invocation_fingerprint_cardinality, alert_pager_count_by_rule. - Post-merge tasks: add synthetic-synth-runner to ops playbook, create runbook snippets linking fingerprint -> trace view. Related work items: ENG-1123, ENG-1189, PM-4561. Notes for oncall: synthesized alerts include the provenance blob (top 3 contributing spans) and a direct deeplink to invocation trace; operators can set enable_synthesis:false to bypass fusion if troubleshooting. This PR is conservative about cardinality and includes unit tests asserting stable fingerprinting.
release_notes: Introduces invocation decorators for span/metric enrichment and an Alert Synthesis Engine to coalesce related alerts, reducing noise. Ops can tune fusion thresholds via provided config example.
